panels.description: TJ's head crosses Lake Keel while his body and legs travel along a half-submerged maintenance rail; the tanker hose churns behind him. Keep the lake and route legible, with open water above for sound lettering.
Two thieves monitor the hose on the tanker deck while dry terraces descend toward the water behind them. Keep their faces distinct but unglamorous and leave upper deck space for dialogue.
TJ's detached head angles toward the intake of a siphon drone, scratched ceramic lenses catching the white lamp. Leave the upper half clear.
From shore, older Alex and his granddaughter stand in the sweep of the lamps, visibly exposed against the dark boathouse and lake. Leave the sky and lamp glow open for dialogue.
